snippet.title: 설특집 한복 CQC │ 체탐자: 실존했던 조선시대 특수부대
snippet.description:
오랜만에 정규 콘텐츠로 찾아뵙습니다. 
이번에는 설날을 맞아 한복을 입고 한옥에서 야간 CQC(근접전투)를 해보았습니다. 
한복은 우리나라 고유의 전통의상입니다. 
우리나라 전통의상을 입고 전통가옥에서 현대 무기와 광학장비로 현대 전술을 펼쳐보면 멋있겠다는 아이디어로 본 콘텐츠를 제작하였습니다. 영상에서 착용한 검은 철릭이 고증에 맞는 한복은 아니며 체탐자가 실제로 입었던 의상도 아님을 알려드립니다.

체탐자는 조선 세종 15년에 세종대왕의 명으로 창설되었던 특수부대입니다. 
아래에 임용한 박사님께서 동아비지니스리뷰 27호에 쓰신 글을 인용 및 링크합니다. 한번 읽어보시면 현대의 UDT/SEAL과 참 많이 닮았음을 알 수 있습니다.

"처음에는 여진 지역의 지리· 동정 등을 살피기 위해 간헐적으로 정탐꾼을 보냈던 것 같다. 그러다가 4군6진이 개척되고 여진족과의 충돌이 빈번해지면서 체계화되기 시작했다. 전성기에는 강변의 군사기지마다 3명의 체탐자를 두게 했다. 평안도에만 540명의 체탐자가 있었다.

en.description:
Join our YouTube membership!

Follow me on Instagram
https://www.instagram.com/imjonpark

Public access to firearms in South Korea is heavily restricted. However, due to the country’s mandatory two-year military service, nearly all able-bodied South Korean males gain some basic experience with firearms.

In Redcell’s return, we’re launching a series focused on current servicemembers in Korea who have only encountered firearms through media or Hollywood portrayals. We believe that a deeper understanding of firearm culture and mechanics can lead to a safer and more informed experience for the men and women in uniform.

In the first video of the series, Jon, a former Korean Navy SEAL, walks us through the fundamentals of pistol recoil control. For many servicemembers, mastering recoil is one of the most critical skills in handling firearms effectively. This episode offers practical insight into managing recoil, improving accuracy, and developing proper technique—skills that go far beyond what basic training often covers. By focusing on the mechanics, Jon provides a solid foundation for those new to firearms or those looking to refine their handling under more realistic conditions.

en.title: Why the Korean military can't train malfunction drills properly
en.description:
Most service members in the ROK military serve in units that require you to turn in every single casing produced during a live-fire training exercise. The cadre subsequently checks to see if the number of brass matches the number of ammunition fired.

Consequently, most units use what's called a 'brass catcher', something that's seldom used in other parts of the world. The 'brass catcher' is attached to the ejection port so that it can conveniently collect the produced casings when the weapon is fired. But here's the catch: the two most common assault rifles in the Korean military are the K1A and the K2 - both of which have charging handles by the ejection port; similar to an AK.

This creates an obvious problem. If the 'brass catcher' is attached to your weapon, you're not going to be able to run malfunction drills (at least not properly anyway).

This video is aimed to serve as a refresher for those currently active in the military. God speed with your 'brass catchers'...

--

snippet.title: 설특집 한복 CQC │ 체탐자: 실존했던 조선시대 특수부대
snippet.description:
오랜만에 정규 콘텐츠로 찾아뵙습니다. 
이번에는 설날을 맞아 한복을 입고 한옥에서 야간 CQC(근접전투)를 해보았습니다. 
한복은 우리나라 고유의 전통의상입니다. 
우리나라 전통의상을 입고 전통가옥에서 현대 무기와 광학장비로 현대 전술을 펼쳐보면 멋있겠다는 아이디어로 본 콘텐츠를 제작하였습니다. 영상에서 착용한 검은 철릭이 고증에 맞는 한복은 아니며 체탐자가 실제로 입었던 의상도 아님을 알려드립니다.

체탐자는 조선 세종 15년에 세종대왕의 명으로 창설되었던 특수부대입니다. 
아래에 임용한 박사님께서 동아비지니스리뷰 27호에 쓰신 글을 인용 및 링크합니다. 한번 읽어보시면 현대의 UDT/SEAL과 참 많이 닮았음을 알 수 있습니다.

"처음에는 여진 지역의 지리· 동정 등을 살피기 위해 간헐적으로 정탐꾼을 보냈던 것 같다. 그러다가 4군6진이 개척되고 여진족과의 충돌이 빈번해지면서 체계화되기 시작했다. 전성기에는 강변의 군사기지마다 3명의 체탐자를 두게 했다. 평안도에만 540명의 체탐자가 있었다.

전술도 점점 발달했다. 처음에는 보통 2, 3명이 한 조가 되어 움직였지만 나중에는 5∼10명으로 늘었다. 이들은 주기적으로 여진 지역에 들어갔으며, 보통 3∼5일씩 활동하고 교대했다. 높은 곳에 숨어 적의 침공을 감시할 때는 2, 3명이 하루치 식량만 들고 강 건너 비밀관측소에서 정보 수집 활동을 했다. 이들은 낮에 은신하고 야간에 이동하며 정찰·잠복 임무를 수행했다."

https://dbr.donga.com/article/view/1306/article_no/1534/ac/a_view

snippet.title: 숨바꼭질: 일일 테러범 체험 Episode 3
snippet.description:
우리는 막상 닥쳐보지 않은 상황을 쉽게 생각하고는 합니다.
그럼 특수부대의 상대방 입장은 어떨까? 테러범의 시점은 어떨까? 어떤 기분일까?
레드셀 제작진이 특수부대를 상대하는 테러범의 심리 상태를 알아보기 위해 섭외한 출연자들이 심박계를 착용하고 숨은 뒤 테러범의 입장을 체험해 보았습니다.

해당 콘텐츠는 대항전 게임이 아니라 체험에 목적이 있습니다. 참여자분들께 무기를 쥐여주면 대원들이 더욱 과격하게 제압을 해야 하기 때문에 다칠 수도 있어 이번 콘텐츠에서는 무기를 제공하지 않고 진행하였습니다. 

또한 해당 콘텐츠에 보여지는 전술은 최신 전술이 아니며 전술 노출 방지를 위해 세부적인 전술 흐름을 바꾸고 많은 부분이 편집되었습니다.

snippet.title: 레드셀 BGM 알려드립니다
snippet.description:
지난 1월 부터 채널을 운영해오면서 많은 분들이 저희 레드셀 영상에 나오는 BGM에 대해 문의를 해주셨습니다. 초기에는 답변을 드렸는데 채널이 급성장하는 이후로 부터는 감당이 안될 정도로 댓글과 이메일로 BGM 문의를 많이 주셨습니다. (심지어 저희 사무실에 전화까지 하셔서 물어보셨던 분도 있습니다)

일일이 답변 들이지 못해서 죄송했는데 문득 생각해보니 BGM 재생목록을 만들어들이는 것도 좋은 방법이라고 생각했습니다.

물론 저희가 영상 상세설명이나 크레딧에 넣어서 알려드릴 수 있지만 작업시간을 최소화하기 위함이니 너그럽게 이해해주셨으면 합니다.

감사합니다!

en-US.title: Hide and Seek: Daily Terrorist Experience Episode 2
en-US.description:
"If we get caught, we can fight back, right?" "Even with a gun, I can just close in quickly and attack, right?"

We tend to overthink situations we haven't actually encountered.
So, what would it be like for the special forces to face the enemy? What would the terrorist's perspective be like? What would it feel like?
To understand the psychological state of a terrorist facing off against special forces, the Red Cell production team recruited participants to wear heart rate monitors, hide, and experience the terrorist's perspective.

This content is not intended as a competitive game, but rather as an experience. Giving participants weapons would force them to be more aggressive in their subduing, which could lead to injury. Therefore, weapons were not provided in this content.

Furthermore, the tactics shown in this content are not the most up-to-date. To prevent exposure, detailed tactical flow has been altered and many parts have been edited.

※ Please understand that the use of profanity during subduing is intended to put pressure on the terrorist.

en.title: Hide and Seek with Korean Navy SEALs EP #2
en.description:
Ever wonder what it'd feel like to be terrorist getting raided? To delve into the mental and physical strains that a terrorist might go through, we've designed a scenario where former Korean Navy SEALs raid a home, weapons drawn. For the sake of everyone's safety, the participants of this exercise were unarmed and the operators were "armed" with airsoft guns that were completely dry. The willing participants were given heart rate monitors, a full face mask, ear-pro, and a protective cup(just in case). They were (mis)informed that the Korean SEAL's were heavily armed with rubber bullets to put them in a more "realistic" mindset. The acting terrorists were given 10 minutes to hide and the SEALs did what they do best.

※ The former Korean SEALs were briefed to refrain from using "up to date" TTPs. Any CQC/CQB you see in the video may be "inaccurate" for security purposes. The main point of this exercise was to measure the acting terrorists' HR and for them to recount their experience.

en.title: Hide and Seek with Korean Navy SEALs (Trailer)
en.description:
※ The first episode will be uploaded tomorrow, October 1st.

Ever wonder what it'd feel like to be terrorist getting raided? To delve into the mental and physical strains that a terrorist might go through, we've designed a scenario where former Korean Navy SEALs raid a home, weapons drawn. For the sake of everyone's safety, the participants of this exercise were unarmed and the operators were "armed" with airsoft guns that were completely dry. The willing participants were given heart rate monitors, a full face mask, ear-pro, and a protective cup(just in case). They were (mis)informed that the Korean SEAL's were heavily armed with rubber bullets to put them in a more "realistic" mindset. The acting terrorists were given 10 minutes to hide and the SEALs did what they do best.

※ The former Korean SEALs were briefed to refrain from using "up to date" TTPs. Any CQC/CQB you see in the video may be "inaccurate" for security purposes. The main point of this exercise was to measure the acting terrorists' HR and for them to recount their experience.

Jon is a former operator from the Republic of Korea Naval Special Warfare Flotilla (commonly known as ROK SEALs). He is the CEO and owner of REDCELL.

※ NOTE ※
Live fire training, at least anything meaningful, is non existent in Korea. The only reliable training options available in the country are airsoft weapons.

Airsoft is no equivalent to the real thing. But it’s good enough to get the mechanics down. You just have to be cognizant of the differences and to be aware of any bad habits you might be baking in.

en.title: Gun vs Knife
en.description:
Don't bring a knife to a gun fight? Or is the 21-foot rule as accurate as they claim. Of course, results may vary depending on the circumstance, situation, and the level of each individual armed with a knife or a gun.

In this video, Jon and Lee put it to the test at various distances - 7m, 5m, 3m, and finally at 2m (approx. 23ft, 16ft, 10ft, and 7ft). 

The rules are simple. Jon will have his airsoft Glock19 holstered and Lee will have the visibly in-hand. There will be two variations of the test at each distance - one, Jon will have his hand on the holster and two, Jon will have his hand naturally rest at his side.

In a more realistic scenario, a gun would be drawn and aimed at the aggressor with the knife if it is presently in-hand. But it only takes 0.2 sec for someone to visually recognize a threat and pull the trigger. So to up the stakes we've decided to have the pistol holstered.

Note: There is no perfect way to test this as the person with the pistol is already on high alert before reacting on visual cues. So please bear this in mind.
